    my @a = (1,2); our %h = (2 => "two"); { local $h{@a} = "loc"; print "$h{2}\n"; }
  perl 5.40.3: loc        PCL (s530a): two        (emission: (p-local-hash-elem-init %h @a "loc"))
Probe scratch/s530a/pr/c3.pl row 2.  The natural owner is the codegen review's C2 (close the text seam one statement kind per session, `local` first): once `local` lowers through ExprToCL the key rule applies by construction; a fix in Parser.pm's text path would be a second copy of the rule (CLAUDE.md rule 11).
